technical.summary: ACN shows long-term uptrend structure (EMA 50/200 bullish, ADX trending) but is in acute downtrend with price below all key moving averages, negative MACD, bearish stochastic cross, and three black crows pattern—insufficient confluence for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 10 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (35/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (101+ days old) with no conviction from senior members.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (455.84), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and earnings in 10 days create a highly adverse macro backdrop for ACN.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA 50/200 bullish structure with ADX trending, extreme fear sentiment (35/100) offers contrarian entry, and price near support (291.03) provides defined risk with 10-day earnings catalyst potential.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, deeply negative MACD (-9.68), active bearish stochastic cross, three black crows pattern, zero fundamental conviction, crisis VIX backdrop, and high earnings risk within 10 days create overwhelming confluence of downside pressure.
